title: Register a live WebSocket/SSE route (core/websocket_manager has no served endpoint)
body: core/websocket_manager.py defines ws_manager/WSEventType/setup_ws_events but no live route is registered (the stdlib server cannot serve WS). The dashboard MVP needs live stage/agent status + streamed logs (P12). Register a real WS or SSE endpoint on the live backend. Refs: core/websocket_manager.py:211,251; dashboard/server.py:144.
